patient.living_situation: Lives alone; her grandchildren live nearby
patient.social_context: Close to her grandchildren; limited contact with friends since her partner died
patient.co_occurring_symptoms: Chronic knee pain; sleep difficulty; grief
patient.background: Fictional retired teacher, widowed, who lives alone close to her grandchildren.
patient.history_summary: Cannabis use that began after knee surgery in 2019 for pain and sleep and became daily in 2022.
patient.treatment_summary: Discussed use with her family doctor in 2024; has attended a short outpatient group since September 2025.

history_events.description: After knee surgery, begins using cannabis for pain and sleep.
Use becomes daily, in the morning and evening.
Raises her cannabis use with her family doctor.

factors.description: Knee pain that flares in the evening.
Anniversaries related to her partner's death.
Regular time with her grandchildren, which she wants to protect.
Hides her use from her family.
Worries about driving after use and avoids it.

interventions.reported_outcome: Discussed her use during one appointment; no further contact followed.

progress.note: Uses in the morning and evening; thinking about cutting down.
Reports using mainly in the evening.
Uses on fewer days than six months earlier.
